scripts.speaker: Wolf
scripts.text: Are you here to join the protest? But you don't seem like an experienced protester.
- This quest is available from level 170 onward. -

scripts.speaker: Ordinary Person
scripts.text: This area is under maintenance and access is prohibited. It's dangerous. Please step back.

scripts.speaker: Ordinary Person
scripts.text: This area is under maintenance and access is prohibited.

scripts.speaker: Suad
scripts.text: You don't need to be cautious. This person is an adventurer who is with us.

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: Are we all gathered now?

scripts.speaker: Suad
scripts.text: Yeah, everyone's ready. We just need to signal our people scattered around and enter the temple.

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: We need to move quickly.

scripts.speaker: Suad
scripts.text: When we enter here, we can go towards the side entrance of the temple. We'll enter when we receive a response after sending the signal over there. Adventure, can you send the signal?
We need to be prepared.
Beep-

scripts.speaker: Suad
scripts.text: Since we've sent the signal, the emergency passage will open soon. Let us know when you're ready. We'll enter immediately.

scripts.speaker: Suad
scripts.text: ^ff0000An unknown error occurred.^000000

scripts.speaker: Suad
scripts.text: We haven't sent the signal yet. Once everyone is ready, we'll send the signal immediately.

scripts.speaker: Suad
scripts.text: ^ff0000Only a member of the party can enter the Memorial Dungeon.^000000

scripts.speaker: Suad
scripts.text: The signal has come, so let's move. Let's enter right away.

scripts.speaker: Suad
scripts.text: Right. Adventurers are also essential forces, so let's wait until they're ready.

scripts.speaker: Ordinary Person
scripts.text: Hello, adventurer. An agent from a temple has been waiting for you.

scripts.speaker: Suad
scripts.text: Where's the party leader?

scripts.speaker: Suad
scripts.text: It's not looking good right now. I think... The armed guards increasing their security..
Looks like the issue with the riot on top is a big one.

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: Or the information was leaked. Otherwise, we wouldn't have been prepared.

scripts.speaker: Temple Guard
scripts.text: No further entry is permitted. Surrender to your arrest.

scripts.speaker: Natives
scripts.text: What have we done? We're not supposed to be in here!

scripts.speaker: Natives
scripts.text: This is our land! If the owner wants to enter into their own land, why should anyone be stopping them?

scripts.speaker: Natives
scripts.text: You're the ones who are illegally occupying it!

scripts.speaker: Natives
scripts.text: What the hell, give it back!! Our land!!

scripts.speaker: Native Leader
scripts.text: We are the longtime owners of this land and have been displaced from our homes by the settlers.

scripts.speaker: Native Leader
scripts.text: We have come to claim our rightful place as the longtime inhabitants of this land.

scripts.speaker: Native Leader
scripts.text: Our demands are as follows.

scripts.speaker: Native Leader
scripts.text: One! We have...

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: Suad, did you give any specific instructions to the people who were rioting at the top?

scripts.speaker: Suad
scripts.text: No? Why?

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: See those guys over there? They're moving cautiously. That's the group that did the attack on the top.

scripts.speaker: Suad
scripts.text: I didn't give you any instructions. Are you trying to act on your own?
Looks like they're heading for the temple.

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: It's an action that's not discussed beforehand. I already have a history, and that's not a good thing, is it? I'm going to have to tread quietly, I don't know what else I'm going to do..

scripts.speaker: Suad
scripts.text: Are you going alone?

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: I'm just following behind, why do I need a group? I'm good enough on my own. You stay here, I'll signal if anything happens.

scripts.speaker: Suad
scripts.text: They say that they're only following, but there's no telling what they might be doing. Even if they're unarmed, they might be hiding something...

scripts.speaker: Suad
scripts.text: Well, that's a relief. I can't make any hasty moves here. Miriam left a trace. Now do me a favor and just follow the trace.

scripts.speaker: Suad
scripts.text: Be careful.

scripts.speaker: Temple Guard
scripts.text: This place is off-limits.

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: I'm Miriam, the daughter of High Priest Amal. We've been following a suspicious group of people into this area..

scripts.speaker: Temple Guard
scripts.text: Are you here to help the High Priest with his work?

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: Work... help...? Is my father here?

scripts.speaker: Temple Guard
scripts.text: Ah...

scripts.speaker: Temple Guard
scripts.text: No one here is suspicious. You may leave now.

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: Are you sure there aren't any suspicious people coming in? They've obviously gotten into this place, give me a second and I'll check it out quickly.

scripts.speaker: Temple Guard
scripts.text: If you get any closer, we will take action.

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: ...Can't help it, then. Can you, Adventurer?
Yes. I'll handle it, you go after them.

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: Then do me a favor, I'll leave a trail so you can find me..

scripts.speaker: Temple Guard
scripts.text: Intruder...! Argh!!!

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: What are you doing here?

scripts.speaker: Lamacus
scripts.text: Whoa! What the hell are you doing here, with an Adventurer?

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: You shouldn't be here right now. If the Temple finds out, it will only make things more difficult for us.

scripts.speaker: Lamacus
scripts.text: Don't you see? We're breaking into a library. There must be a lot of secrets of the settlers in here.

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: We can think about that later. For now. Go back. Your actions now could put us in more danger..

scripts.speaker: Yopi
scripts.text: Go home, Miriam. I'm not going to cooperate with your stuffy behavior anymore.

scripts.speaker: Temple Guard
scripts.text: There, intruder!

scripts.speaker: Temple Guard
scripts.text: Everyone lay down your weapons and raise your hands!
How do I do this?

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: We're outnumbered, let's deal with it.

scripts.speaker: Kun
scripts.text: Good timing. Then we'll say goodbye!

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: Hold on, Adventurer!
Leave this one to me!

scripts.speaker: Lamacus
scripts.text: Did you find it? What kind of a place is this?

scripts.speaker: Kun
scripts.text: Not yet. I don't think it's on this side. Oh, wait... The High Priest's...?

scripts.speaker: Yopi
scripts.text: Leave the irrelevant books alone. That's not what we're looking for.

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: You guys...!
Shhh-hold on a second.

scripts.speaker: Lamacus
scripts.text: Even the most secretive of libraries wouldn't just leave a book like that lying around.

scripts.speaker: Kun
scripts.text: So is there another secret library within the secret library?

scripts.speaker: Yopi
scripts.text: I don't know. Let's just find it.

scripts.speaker: Kun
scripts.text: It would be nice to know the book title.

scripts.speaker: Lamacus
scripts.text: If I knew that, I wouldn't be here. I'd be like, 'Bring me anything that looks like that.' Go find it.
Doesn't it look like they're looking for a specific book?

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: A specific book...? Not just a book to exploit weaknesses?

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: No, you mean this? Hey! What are you looking for? For what purpose?

scripts.speaker: Yopi
scripts.text: Oh, there you go again! Why are you eavesdropping? As if you have something shady to share.

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: You're the ones who sneaked in with the shady stuff, remember? What's the book you're looking for?

scripts.speaker: Lamacus
scripts.text: That really hurts, man. Don't you realize that we're trying to make a good thing out of this? Can't you understand that we're trying to make a better life for everyone?

scripts.speaker: Lamacus
scripts.text: They'll never know how much we care. It's about time you showed up, by the way...

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: You have to catch them and make them open their mouths...!

scripts.speaker: Temple Guard
scripts.text: Here we go! The intruder is here!!!

scripts.speaker: Temple Guard
scripts.text: Drop your weapon!!

scripts.speaker: Yopi
scripts.text: Isn't this the end of the line?

scripts.speaker: Lamacus
scripts.text: I know. They must have a real secret library.

scripts.speaker: Lamacus
scripts.text: I told you to find it in the first place, not just come to me because it's there.

scripts.speaker: Kun
scripts.text: Ask if it's okay to back out.

scripts.speaker: Kun
scripts.text: Wait, am I seeing things? That's Miriam and the Adventurer.

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: Who are you guys talking to?
Are you guys paid to do this?

scripts.speaker: Lamacus
scripts.text: Payment? We don't get that, do we?
Is this the end of the library?

scripts.speaker: Lamacus
scripts.text: Yes, it is.
I wish I could have found the book, but I can't. They've done their work, so we're out of here.

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: Who are you? What do you have to do with these people?
What is it? Is there something else?

scripts.speaker: Yopi
scripts.text: Someone sniffed out the wolf and decided to follow us. We'll take care of it soon.
That's not necessary. You guys should get out of here and let the new guys take over.

scripts.speaker: Lamacus
scripts.text: Yes!!

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: Wait!!!

scripts.speaker: Temple Guard
scripts.text: Take care of all intruders!

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: It seems like a weird twist of fate, huh? The Temple Guards have been bought off. We need to find out what's going on...

scripts.speaker: Temple Guard
scripts.text: All hands in formation!

scripts.speaker: Yopi
scripts.text: Oh, no~ I'm sorry we've crossed paths, we got dirty, so let's not meet again?

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: What are you doing? How many people are there? I can't see much from here.
There are a few people I don't recognize.
How far are we from there?

scripts.speaker: Lamacus
scripts.text: We're almost there now.
It's really, really, really secure. I'm just saying.
... Aren't you at least this secure?
Hey, Mr. Genius, don't you know how to make an irony?! Tight security is not synonymous with cumbersome and demanding procedures, right?

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: This voice is...
Do you know them?

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: It's obscured, so I'm not sure...
Enter.

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: Let's go in too.
Schulang, have you secured it yet? This Bagot is about to lose patience.

scripts.speaker: Lamacus
scripts.text: But do we have to keep this on?

scripts.speaker: Schulang
scripts.text: Who cares? You came this far. Do as you please.

scripts.speaker: Yopi
scripts.text: Hah- now that's a life saver.
The Heart Hunters were undercover.

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: Hearthunter... you're working with those mad scientists you were talking about... from the very beginning...!
There are still a lot of Heart Hunters remodeled with Ymir's heart left, right?

scripts.speaker: Schulang
scripts.text: Was it our old face? Ah, those are the small fries that are said to be tracking you. I heard the news.
That would be Illusion.

scripts.speaker: Bagot
scripts.text: Oh, my God, I don't want to embarrass you.
You're all good to go.

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: ...Father??

scripts.speaker: Amal
scripts.text: Miriam, You've come this far. You've done your part, now go home.

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: What do you mean? What are you doing...?

scripts.speaker: Bagot
scripts.text:
Wow, you got praised by your dad. That's great. Compliments for good parenting, it's important.
I don't even remember getting my praise. Um... Ah! I don't remember because I never got it.!

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: What, what's going on? Why did my dad... What did you do?

scripts.speaker: Amal
scripts.text: ... Once you've got what you need, let's move on.

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: Father! Father!!!

scripts.speaker: Bagot
scripts.text: A father who praises you but never loves you?

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: What are you doing to my father?

scripts.speaker: Bagot
scripts.text: Oh, you don't know, do you? His wish is to drive all the natives out of Arunafeltz. We helped a little with that, but not for free.

scripts.speaker: Heart Hunter
scripts.text: Miriam, you and your friends have helped me complete this picture of the riot. Thank you so much!

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: Do you think that makes sense?

scripts.speaker: Bagot
scripts.text: What are you talking about, a handful of impulsive protests to the temple?

scripts.speaker: Bagot
scripts.text: Soon the protest outside will turn into a riot, and then your wish will be granted, and then you'll make another wish, and then we'll get paid again?

scripts.speaker: Schulang
scripts.text:
I'm not going to talk forever. Let's go.
Clean up your mess.

scripts.speaker: Lamacus
scripts.text: Four!

scripts.speaker: Heart Hunter
scripts.text: I wish I had Suad here with me. I wish I could've helped him out sometime.

scripts.speaker: Heart Hunter
scripts.text: Hi, let me formally introduce ourselves. We're the Heart Hunters, and we're about to bury you here.
Watch out, they're modified.

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: He's always been like that... Is there something ominous about that?
It seems to resonate with the heart of Ymir here.

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: That's basically a quick count, right? Okay, let's make it quick and get on with it.

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: Ha... Hah... Adventurer, are you all right?
But where did they all go?

scripts.speaker: Niren
scripts.text:
What, what's all the fuss about?
Adventurer...? Why are you here, Adventurer?
Here's what...

scripts.speaker: Niren
scripts.text: You've been tracking a colleague who's been acting suspiciously, and it turns out they're actually a mole.

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: You're in the same league as my father.?

scripts.speaker: Niren
scripts.text: High Priest?? What does that even mean?

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: I think my father is involved in this.

scripts.speaker: Niren
scripts.text:
How is that... High Priest...? We'll have to investigate.
I'm sure there are instigators lurking in the crowd outside, planted by the bad guys...
It's also among the Temple Guard.

scripts.speaker: Niren
scripts.text: We're going to need to do a major overhaul...first we need to figure out what we've been doing here, making sure there's nothing dangerous, and nothing is lost... even among the Temple Guards.

scripts.speaker: Niren
scripts.text:
...!!
No need to investigate, Ymir's heart shard is missing. It's supposed to be there.
I know...

scripts.speaker: Niren
scripts.text:
What the heck they're going to do with it... I can't even imagine.
This is not what we should be doing, we need to tell the truth and track them down...!!

scripts.speaker: Niren
scripts.text: Ah...! You said there would be enemies among the Temple Guards, so we'll have to pick out the ones we trust first.

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: I'll go. That's probably my father's, because I have a pretty good idea of where it might have gone.

scripts.speaker: Niren
scripts.text: We'll talk about that when we get outside, because it's not looking good out there.

scripts.speaker: Crowd
scripts.text: Acknowledge us!

scripts.speaker: Crowd
scripts.text: We're alive! We are here!!

scripts.speaker: Crowd
scripts.text: This is Our Land!

scripts.speaker: Crowd
scripts.text: Return the land to the rightful owners of the land!

scripts.speaker: Temple Guard
scripts.text: If you dismiss now, we will not charge you for trespassing on the temple!

scripts.speaker: Temple Guard
scripts.text: I'll give you exactly 30 minutes! Go back within the time limit!

scripts.speaker: Crowd
scripts.text: Are you threatening us now?

scripts.speaker: Crowd
scripts.text: What are you going to do?

scripts.speaker: Crowd
scripts.text: You're going to arrest everyone and put them in jail, right?

scripts.speaker: Crowd
scripts.text: At this point, let's go in first!!!

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: Something's not right. People are getting too aggressive.

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: This doesn't look good. I need to get Suad, but where's the deputy?

scripts.speaker: Niren
scripts.text: There you are. I brought along Priest Zhed.

scripts.speaker: Zhed
scripts.text: What's going on here? Does it have something to do with the people who have flocked here? Or, is there something inside the temple that's causing this...

scripts.speaker: Suad
scripts.text: What's going on? You said it's something urgent.

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: Once you've got it covered, move fast. They're waiting for you at the safe house.

scripts.speaker: Suad
scripts.text: What's going on?

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: We have a mole among us.

scripts.speaker: Suad
scripts.text: A mole? Where?

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: Suad, first of all, give us an overview of the situation here. It sounds like we're on the verge of a riot, is that right? Oh, hello, Priest Zhed.

scripts.speaker: Suad
scripts.text: Why is the High Priest here?

scripts.speaker: Zhed
scripts.text: Miriam? Did Miriam have anything to do with this?

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: There's a reason for that, but first, let's talk about the situation, Suad?

scripts.speaker: Suad
scripts.text: It's not good. It's spiraling out of control. The temple is coming down hard on us. They're recommending we disband. We're running out of time. We're preparing to evacuate.

scripts.speaker: Suad
scripts.text: What happened to the people you followed?
Let me explain.
- The events inside the temple. -

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: My father and a foreign power conspired to divide Arunafeltz and oppress the natives...

scripts.speaker: Suad
scripts.text: There's a mole among us... but who's the impostor?

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: It's more accurate to say they're gone into hiding than traitorous. They were never on our side to begin with.

scripts.speaker: Suad
scripts.text: So we were almost in the middle of an organized riot from the start?

scripts.speaker: Niren
scripts.text: This is not the time. They've infiltrated the temple as well, so we have to take on both sides..

scripts.speaker: Suad
scripts.text: What's that whistle? It's not our signal.

scripts.speaker: Crowd
scripts.text: Why you're taking clothes off??

scripts.speaker: Temple Guard
scripts.text: Keep your guard up!

scripts.speaker: Crowd
scripts.text: What the hell are you doing??

scripts.speaker: Crowd
scripts.text: Argh!!!! Argh!!! The temple guard grabs a man!!!

scripts.speaker: Temple Guard
scripts.text: It's a riot! Put it down!

scripts.speaker: Miriam
scripts.text: Oh... I'm late...!

scripts.speaker: Suad
scripts.text: We need to stop the brute-force attackers.

scripts.speaker: Niren
scripts.text: I'll evacuate the people.

scripts.speaker: Temple Guard Captain
scripts.text: Well done, everyone! The cleansing will continue daily! Let's disband for today and take a rest!

scripts.speaker: Temple Guard Captain
scripts.text: Adventurer, thank you for your assistance.

scripts.speaker: Temple Guard Captain
scripts.text: I've heard that you'll also be joining us for a separate cleansing operation inside the temple. We'll be counting on you!
